name: Dremio MCP
description: Query Dremio lakehouse data in plain language from Claude, ChatGPT, or your own agent: run SQL, read schemas and lineage, and review failed jobs. For data teams.

skills.name: Run SQL Queries
skills.description: Runs SELECT queries on your Dremio cluster and returns the results to the agent for analysis and follow-up questions.

skills.name: Table Schemas
skills.description: Retrieves the schema of Dremio tables and views so the agent knows the columns and types before writing SQL against them.

skills.name: Table And View Lineage
skills.description: Finds the lineage of a Dremio table or view, so the agent can trace which datasets it is built from before using it.

skills.name: Semantic Search
skills.description: Searches across the Dremio cluster semantically to find relevant datasets; it must be enabled in the server's config file.

skills.name: Failed Jobs And Usage Reports
skills.description: Analyzes failed and canceled Dremio jobs from the past 7 days and builds usage reports grouped by engines or projects.
